metadata.change_reason: Requirement analysis and demand falsification standard, covering 5W1H, workaround verification, painkiller rating, and non-goals

spec.name: Requirement Analysis & Demand Falsification Quality Standard

rules.statement: All 6 dimensions of 5W1H (Why, Who, What, When, Where, How) must be clearly answered without empty slots or placeholders
Must perform demand falsification assessment including current user workarounds and painkiller classification
Must explicitly declare at least 2 Non-Goals defining scope and capability boundaries
